title: Topic
description: Schema for a syllabus topic, capturing its importance, exam frequency, prerequisite relationships, and structured content sections for study material generation.

unit_number.description: Syllabus unit number this topic belongs to.

unit_title.description: Title of the parent syllabus unit.

syllabus_id.description: Identifier of the syllabus this topic is sourced from.

subtopics.description: List of narrower subtopics within this topic.

prerequisite_topics.description: Topic IDs that should be studied before this topic.

related_topics.description: Topic IDs that are conceptually related.

importance_level.description: Relative importance based on exam frequency and syllabus weight.

exam_frequency.description: Historical exam-appearance statistics for this topic.

times_appeared.description: Total number of times questions from this topic have appeared.

years.description: List of exam years in which this topic appeared.

evidence_type.description: How the frequency data was derived.

content_sections.description: Structured content blocks for this topic, used in study material generation.

caption.description: Caption or title of the diagram.

diagram_type.description: Type of diagram (e.g. flowchart, block-diagram, circuit, graph).

content.description: Mermaid, ASCII, or other renderable diagram source.

key_terms.description: Important terms and their short definitions related to this topic.

common_mistakes.description: Frequently made errors students should avoid when answering questions on this topic.
